_area_help: areas = what visitors see. area_cities = town names given to search engines (areaServed).
_form_help: POST endpoint for the lesson request form (FormSubmit). Can be swapped for FormSubmit's random-string alias (https://formsubmit.co/<alias>) after activation. FormSubmit sends a one-time activation email to the address on the first real submission; someone must click Activate before requests arrive. null = the form is hidden and visitors use call/text/email.
book_text: Send a lesson request with your preferred times and skill level, and Lucas will get back to you to set up your first lesson.
_book_help: The lesson request form is the only contact method on the site (no phone or email is published).
